summary: Expose truthful optional message author and recipient identities without widening legacy sender/destination types

replay.detail: No replay, native fold or message regrouping.

schema.detail: Optional TimelineMessageBody.author ActorRef and recipients ParticipantRef[] behind conversation-message-participants.v1. Existing from/to types unchanged; authored/generated codecs updated.

rules.detail: No claim, SEND, receipt, authority, canonical operation or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Daemons first. Old/unnegotiated clients receive neither new field. Known legacy scalar values remain; an invalid optional daemon from is omitted rather than mislabeled. New author comes only from the actual canonical claim actor; recipients contains its proven destination.

downtime.detail: Ordinary update; no extra host operation.

recovery.detail: Projection-only fields, no additional durable state or writer.
